safetyClasses.R-IP: read-only IP management, no device or group state change
safetyClasses.R-BUS: read-only bus frame, elicits responses but changes no state
safetyClasses.BLOCKED: must not run until the named defect is fixed

tests.name: passive routing listen
tests.command: external socket joined to 224.0.23.12:3671, no sends
tests.evidence: routing frames with reachable hop counts and sources

tests.name: discovery unicast and multicast
tests.evidence: DIB name, individual address, MAC, supported families
preconditions: gateway IP known or multicast allowed

tests.name: tunnel connect and disconnect
tests.evidence: CONNECT channel and assigned address, ACK 0x00, DISCONNECT 0x00
tests.observed: channel 16, assigned 1.0.1, connect 22 ms, clean disconnect

tests.name: heartbeat longer than 60 s
tests.command: tunnel listen for 75 s, no cEMI
tests.observed: response 0x00 at 60 s, 49 forwarded telegrams, clean disconnect

tests.name: group monitor via tunnel, listen only
tests.evidence: forwarded frames decoded to group address, APCI and DPT
abort: any frame from the tunnel's own assigned address
tests.observed: 35 of 49 group frames classified as individual, all writes decoded as reads

tests.name: group value read for an approved GA
tests.evidence: GroupValueResponse from the device, plausible DPT value, 1-3 s

tests.name: individual address read
tests.blocker: broadcast management frame is outside the read-test scope

tests.name: ACK retry and timeout
tests.command: loopback test; real read with an unused GA
tests.evidence: one repeat with the same sequence, then failure
tests.blocker: no packet loss injection on real hardware

tests.name: interface conflict
tests.command: open a tunnel, then bus_connect again or start an ETS tunnel
preconditions: user confirms ETS may be interrupted
tests.blocker: avoid disturbing a live ETS session

tests.name: routing mode
abort: Connected but zero frames in 60 s
tests.blocker: B5 KnxRouting does not join the multicast group

defects.impact: 35 of 49 real group frames classified as individual

defects.summary: APCI and payload read from the wrong APDU octets
defects.impact: every real group write decoded as GroupValueRead with shifted payload

defects.summary: L_Data.con is dispatched as a telegram; bus_read matches any telegram to the GA
defects.impact: bus_read returns the confirmation echo after 43 ms

defects.summary: descriptor read encoded as APCI nibble plus a data byte; descriptor type not expressible
defects.impact: bus_device_info, bus_scan and Diagnostics are unusable on real hardware

defects.summary: OpenAsync never joins 224.0.23.12 and never binds 3671
defects.impact: routing mode reports Connected but receives nothing

approvalsRequired: exact GA and device for R6 and R7 with expected DPT
confirmation that no ETS session is active
explicit approval for the first post-fix group read
explicit approval for the second-tunnel conflict test
